semantics: These are fail-closed evidence gates. READY means the rule is specified, not that parcel evidence passed.

gates.name: HMLR ZIP/GML official-byte chain
gates.rule: The download page must remain on the HMLR host; the ZIP final host must be HTTPS and allowlisted as HMLR or datapub-prd-s3-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com. ZIP and extracted GML must be non-empty and independently SHA-256 hashed before parsing.

gates.name: HMLR native BNG polygon structure
gates.rule: Before handoff, require native EPSG:27700, only valid non-empty positive-area Polygon or MultiPolygon geometry, plausible British National Grid bounds, one non-empty unique Land Registry-INSPIRE identifier per polygon and a hash of the sorted identifier set. Do not silently reproject a non-BNG source.

gates.name: Point reprojection risk
gates.rule: HMLR guidance warns BNG-to-WGS84 conversion may shift features by up to 15m; matching must remain fail-closed.

gates.name: Unique direct point-in-polygon
gates.rule: A canonical EPSG:27700 point must intersect exactly one preflight-verified INSPIRE polygon for direct binding.

gates.name: 15m fallback candidate handling
gates.rule: A 15m search may create candidates only; it cannot create a canonical polygon binding without unique corroboration.

gates.name: GeoTIFF response signature
gates.rule: Require classic TIFF byte-order/version magic and successful rasterio opening with image/tiff or octet-stream semantics.

gates.name: GeoTIFF CRS and grid
gates.rule: Raster must resolve as EPSG:27700 with approximately 1m cells and cover the requested bbox.

gates.name: Finite DTM pixels
gates.rule: Exclude nodata/non-finite cells; require at least one valid terrain pixel inside the bound polygon.

gates.name: Terrain height-difference formula
gates.rule: Primary result is polygon DTM max minus polygon DTM min, in metres AOD.

gates.name: DSM semantic isolation
gates.rule: DTM service QA and full-polygon DTM are required. DSM is optional surface/object QA; DSM failure cannot replace, suppress or erase an otherwise valid DTM terrain result.

gates.name: Survey-date metadata and CRS
gates.rule: Require the official Composite collection, explicit EPSG:27700 bbox/response CRS, one exact BNG geometry match, official response and feature hashes, required fields, valid resolution, ordered survey dates and calendar-year consistency.

gates.name: Final business-row evidence
gates.rule: Write a business row only after allowlisted HMLR ZIP host, ZIP/GML/identifier-set/polygon/DTM hashes, unique binding, valid DTM pixels, min/max and strict survey provenance are all present.
